scientific_integrity: The complete inequality, equality characterization and optimal stability exponent follow from analytic convex-support and operator-norm calculations. The scalar coefficient 1/(2π) is not asserted sharp.
scientific_limitations: Only bounded operators on complex Hilbert spaces. Optimal cubic exponent but no optimal constant. Analytic proof does not depend on finite numerical experiments. Independent audit not performed.
title: Cubic operator-norm stability for the \(L^2\)-Cartesian numerical radius
